plain: An intrusion into what belongs to another, or a gain made at its expense

webster.text: The entrance of an enemy into a country with purposes of hostility; a sudden or desultory incursion or invasion.

example.quote: RANDOLPH disclaimed any intention to give indefinite powers to the national Legislature, declaring that he was entirely opposed to such an inroad on the State jurisdictions, and that he did not think any considerations whatever could ever change his determination.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, May 31, 1787
